description: §38.10.2 clean neg — an `onclient:*` binding name that names nothing in scope (`e`) compiles with no E-CHANNEL-HANDLER-SHADOW; the declared `<x>` is read inside the handler. The delta from `channel/handler-onclient-shadow` is the binding name.
rationale: §38.10.1: the parameter name in the call expression names the injected event object; a fresh name hides nothing.
